answer: A workable Sybil defense makes every agent identity carry an escrowed stake forfeited on proven coordination. Each agent pays real capital to enter, and the deposit stays locked rather than acting as a refundable voucher. A fleet of a thousand puppets needs a thousand live stakes, so the attacker's burn scales with identity count instead of staying flat. Detectors watch for a spiral of synchronized votes and refund-seeking; one confirmed ring loses every member's deposit. Because the loser pays on exit and entry, the voyage into forgery stops paying, and jade reputation proves worthless.
